name: ORD_RESEARCH_ASSOC_HX
description:
This table contains information about the changes that have occurred to the association between an order and research studies after an order has been signed. If the research association of an order has not been modified, it will not appear in this table.


Each row is one change event for an order.

columns.name: ORDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the order record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: ASSOCIATING_USER_ID
columns.description: User ID responsible for the change on this line of this order.

columns.name: ASSOCIATING_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: ASSOCIATED_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: The date and time when the order had its research association changed after signing.

columns.name: RESEARCH_ID_RESEARCH_STUDY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the research study record.

columns.name: PREV_RESEARCH_ID_RESEARCH_STUDY_NAME
columns.description: The name of the research study record.

columns.name: RSH_CODE_FROM_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the source that was used to modify the research association of this order in this modification event.

columns.name: PREV_RSH_CODE_FROM_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the source that was used to modify the research association in the previous modification event.
